200.description: SDK AdminUiResponse envelope - `{ "ok": true, "page": { AdminPage } }` where `AdminPage` is the RFW page definition (title + widgets[]; widgets are the tagged RemoteWidget union: card/text/data_table). Also served for the shared Shield Policy Studio pages matching `sentin8::rfw::policy_page`.

AdminUiAction.description: An action button shown in the page header.

endpoint.description: Endpoint to POST to (for submit actions).

icon.description: Material Icons code point (hex string) for the button.

route.description: Route to navigate to (for link actions).

AdminUiActionType.description: The kind of a header action button.

AdminUiPage.description: A complete admin UI page definition returned by `GET /v1/admin/ui/{page}`.

actions.description: Optional actions shown in the page header (buttons).

title.description: The page title (shown in breadcrumb and header).

oneOf.description: Redirect to this route (e.g. after a successful form submission).
An error occurred (validation error, server error, etc.).

AdminUiResponse.description:
The response from an admin UI endpoint.

- `GET /v1/admin/ui/{page}` → `AdminUiResponse::Page(page_def)`
- `POST /v1/admin/{resource}` → `AdminUiResponse::Page(updated_page_def)` or `AdminUiResponse::Redirect(route)`

AnalyticsDailyRow.description: One daily bucket of the ad-clicks breakdown (last 30 days).

impressions.description: Proxied from clicks pending an impressions table.

revenue.description: Revenue is not yet tracked; reported as `"0"`.

rate_multiplier.description: Multiplier actually applied to the pushed sell prices.

is_enabled.description: Upsert keeps configs enabled unless explicitly `false`.

ChannelConfigResponse.description: Wire row of a channel config (`meta.channel_configs` projection).

rate_multiplier.description: `NUMERIC(5,2)::text` wire - decimal precision preserved as a string.

channel_code.description: Ad-platform channel code (empty string when omitted).

ChannelDeletedResponse.description:
Envelope of `DELETE /v1/channels/{channel_id}` (200 with the deleted id;
the 404 body is a plain error string).

property_id.description: Filter by property; absent lists every channel in the environment.

ChannelUpdateRequest.description:
Body of `PUT /v1/channels/{channel_id}` (all fields optional - absent
keys keep the stored value via `COALESCE`).

api_key_ref.description: Store-by-reference pointer only (never a plaintext key).

ChannelUpdatedResponse.description:
Wire row of `PUT /v1/channels/{channel_id}` (RETURNING projection;
`api_key_ref` is always present, `null` when no credential is stored).

ContainerDirection.description: Layout direction for a container's children.

ContentRoomType.description:
Room-type projection pushed to the metasearch channel (sourced from the
PMS room-type API; `description` is `null` when the PMS has none).

CredentialRequest.description:
Body of `POST /v1/channels/{channel_id}/credentials`. The plaintext api
key is consumed by the handler and envelope-encrypted with the platform
master key; only the ciphertext (and a channel-row reference) is stored.
